ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Advent Hotels International Limited has finalized the acquisition of the remaining 25% equity stake in BD&P Hotels (India) Private Limited, making BD&P Hotels a wholly-owned subsidiary. This strategic move grants Advent full operational and financial control, simplifying the ownership structure for complete integration. The document is a standard regulatory update confirming the transaction's completion, with no immediate red flags identified regarding its terms or impacts within this specific announcement.
